question: A 25-year-old male visits his physician because of fertility issues with his wife. Physical exam reveals bilateral gynecomastia, elongated limbs, and shrunken testicles. Levels of plasma gonadotropins are elevated. Which of the following is also likely to be increased in this patient:?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Elevated plasma gonadotropins" -> "Primary testicular failure" -> "Decreased testosterone production" -> "Increased levels of inhibin" -> 80% CHAIN: "Elevated plasma gonadotropins" -> "Primary testicular failure" -> "Decreased testosterone production" -> "Increased aromatase activity" -> 70% CHAIN: "Elevated plasma gonadotropins" -> "Primary testicular failure" -> "Decreased testosterone production" -> "Decreased ejaculatory sperm production" -> 60% CHAIN: "Elevated plasma gonadotropins" -> "Primary testicular failure" -> "Decreased testosterone production" -> "Increased Sertoli cell activity" -> 80%
enhanced_information: In a patient with primary testicular failure presenting with elevated plasma gonadotropins, decreased testosterone production is expected. This leads to increased levels of inhibin and potentially increased Sertoli cell activity. Testosterone levels are likely to be decreased, so it is not expected to be increased in this patient. Aromatase activity may increase due to the imbalance in testosterone production. Ejaculatory sperm production is likely to decrease in this scenario.
